## Plugin reference

- Description: Global toast notifications: a plain showToast() backed by sonner's global API, plus the Core.Root-mounted sonner Toaster host. Degrades to a silent no-op when no host is mounted. A toast declaring audience developer is shown only in Developer mode. useSuppressToasts() lets a surface that is its whole document (the menu-bar panel) turn the host off while mounted.

## Click-to-dismiss

Clicking a toast anywhere dismisses it — except a click that ends a text
selection (so its words can be copied), and a click on a control inside it (a
button, link or input: its action, a custom toast's ×, a popover trigger),
which is the control's own: it acts, and dismisses itself if it means to. The
check runs in the body's native `<li>` listener (`isControlClick`), not by the
control stopping propagation, which from React would come too late.
